t: Greek War of Independence: At the Battle of Gravia Inn, a 120-man Greek force led by Odysseas Androutsos repulsed an Ottoman army of 8,000 soldiers.
Peruvian War of Independence: Argentine general José de San Martín declared the independence of Peru from the Spanish Empire.
A statue of the Polynesian god A'a was presented to members of the London Missionary Society on the south Pacific island of Ra'iatea.
The Province of Guatemala proclaimed the independence of Central America from the Spanish Empire.
The Declaration of Independence of the Mexican Empire from Spain was drafted in the National Palace in Mexico City.
Dominican separatists in Santo Domingo led by José Núñez de Cáceres proclaimed the establishment of the Republic of Spanish Haiti.
